about: E362 AG6: #engine exports for the game layer and the composition root only (the session, boot, title and installers). wildshard/engine-internal refuses them in src/shards; docs/api/ENGINE.md marks them 'game only'. A shard that needs one asks the lead for a ShardContext verb instead.

names._applyChunkConstants: the registry's level constants, applied by the game when the running shard changes
names.configureLevel: the game selects the running level
names.LevelDriver: the game's level load / unload driver
names.BootRuntime: the boot runtime the game's session receives
names.setTitleArrival: the title's arrival hand-off (the game's travel)
names.TitleArrival: the title's arrival hand-off (the game's travel)
names.Explore: the Explore host, opened by the game's session
names.Feedback: the in-game review note panel (the game's)
names.SaveStore: the save store class (the page's one store is the engine's saves service)
names.retried: the page entry's retried dynamic import
names.installAppIdentity: the composition root installs the app identity
names.installAssetTables: the composition root installs the asset tables
names.installScore: the composition root installs the game's score
names.installEngineStrings: the composition root installs the game's engine strings
